Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.

trend_keywords.window: day D board posts + last-24h posts >= min_views + outsiders + trend-input accounts + pattern brief
trend_keywords.method: sum(log10 views) over distinct posts x author spread x phrase length x entity/brief bonus; >=2 authors
